speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your skin condition, how long have you had these lesions, and have they changed in size, color, or shape recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma. The presentation of non-healing, crusty lesions on a chronic smoker's penis and finger, unresponsive to prior treatments for syphilis and eczema, is highly suspicious for malignancy. I will order a biopsy of the most suspicious lesion immediately. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy
